description: Translate the Chibickmon reunion and Dorulumon rescue lead-in.

Meow! Amazing!
I'm so
meow-pressed!

starting to

weird one?

weird one! You
understand?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

can talk about
that later.

worried, so
let's get back
to the Sky
Fortress.

home, meow!♪

blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

english: Meow-nyo?♪

least we're
glad you found
it safe and
sound!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

W-well, yeah.
It doesn't look
like you got
mixed up in
anything
dangerous.

Though that
Digimon looked
dangerous in a
different
way...

scary souvenir

Key item

West Amazon Key

What is this?
Where did it
come from?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

The twisty key
to Twisting
Amazon! Big sis
said to give it
to Taiki!♪

english:
Give it to
me...? What
does that mean?
Did that
Digimon know
us?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

...Wait a
second. Was
there any other
message?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

Um... Big sis
said Cutemon
wasn't there!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

...I have no
idea what that
means...

Hey, Taiki...
I've got a bad
feeling. When
it says
'Cutemon,
Cutemon,' could
it mean
Cutemon...?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

...But what
does 'Cutemon
isn't there'
mean?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and key-item text translated directly from Japanese; human character names follow the original-name preference.

there,

should be

Let's head to
Twisting
Amazon!

one!

english: Meow...

sorry.

If we beat
these guys,

Cutemon go,
right?
